summary: Calendar/DateField refactor verified end-to-end. Backend: full pytest suite 20/20 pass. Frontend (Expo web, viewport 390x844): DateField pops a calendar modal with the expected testIDs (date-picker-backdrop, date-picker-close, date-picker-clear when a value is set) on every screen exercised — entry (income/expense/trip), onboarding (acq-date, rec-anchor-date), tax-setup (tax-regdate) and settings (set-rec-anchor). No manual typing is possible: entry-date renders as a Pressable (DOM tag=DIV) instead of a TextInput, and selecting a day in the calendar updates the field text to DD/MM/YYYY and closes the modal. End-to-end persistence confirmed via API: after adding via /entry with a picked date, GET /api/income returned 1 income (amount=125.5, date=2026-08-05), GET /api/expenses returned 1 expense (amount=42, fuel, date=2026-08-07), GET /api/trips returned 1 trip (45.5km, 90min, business, date=2026-08-08) — matching the days tapped in the calendar. Onboarding still completes and lands on /home; acq-date opens the calendar and the value flows into 'anchor=acquisition' logic. Regression: /home, /trips, /expenses (Ledger), /reports all load without red-screen or JS errors. NO bugs found for this review; the previous driver_name save bug is now fixed (Settings > 'Your name' onBlur triggers updateProfile — code confirmed at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:109).

Optional cleanup (carried over from prior iterations): migrate style.tintColor -> props.tintColor on expo-image usages to silence the deprecation warning.

Optional (naming inconsistency, not a bug): backend endpoints mix singular/plural — /api/income (singular), /api/expenses & /api/trips (plural). Frontend already uses the correct paths via src/api.tsx; but the review request text says 'POST /api/expense' / 'POST /api/trip' which do NOT exist — real endpoints are the plural forms. Worth aligning for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: DateField in /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx:259-318 correctly renders a Pressable (no manual typing surface), uses react-native-calendars, wires selectedDay -> onChange(dateString) -> setOpen(false), respects maxToday, shows Clear only when value is set (testID date-picker-clear), and Close button (testID date-picker-close). Backdrop is a Pressable with testID date-picker-backdrop that closes the modal — matches the review-request contract exactly.

entry.tsx line 200-202 uses <DateField testID='entry-date' value={dateISO} onChange={setDateISO} maxToday /> for all three kinds (income/expense/trip). Manual Input for date has been fully removed; save() reads dateISO directly. Verified persistence.

onboarding.tsx uses DateField for both acq-date (line 211) and rec-anchor-date (line 252). No stray closing tags detected; bundle compiles cleanly. Recurring 'Count from acquisition' auto-copies acqDate into recAnchorDate on chip change (line 248) — good UX detail.
tax-setup.tsx line 75 uses DateField for registration date, correctly gated behind regStatus === 'registered'.
settings.tsx line 234 uses DateField for set-rec-anchor; previously reported driver_name onBlur fix is now in place at line 109.
